title: Count Anagrams
summary: Given a string s with words separated by single spaces, count the number of distinct anagrams of s.
statement: Given a string s with words separated by single spaces, count the number of distinct anagrams of s. Each anagram must have the same permutation for each corresponding word in s. The result should be modulo 10^9 + 7 to handle large numbers.
constraints: Words are separated by single spaces and remain in their original word positions.
Within each word, permute its letters independently.
Return the number of distinct resulting sentences modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: For each word, begin with factorial(word length).
Divide by factorial(frequency) for every repeated character to remove indistinguishable permutations.
Multiply the independent per-word counts and reduce modulo the prime.
The multinomial coefficient counts each word exactly, and the product rule combines independent word positions.
editorial: The multinomial coefficient counts each word exactly, and the product rule combines independent word positions.
